Container.Name: episode-renamer
Container.Overview:
Renames TV episodes and movies into a clean Plex/Jellyfin layout - Show (Year)/Season 01/Show - S01E01 - Title.mkv and Movie (Year)/Movie (Year).mkv - using TVmaze, TheTVDB, TMDB, or your own Sonarr/Radarr. Previews every change, keeps Sonarr/Radarr in sync after renaming, and can undo a whole batch.
Set "Media" to the share that holds your TV and Movies folders, then open the WebUI.

Config.Name: Media
Config.Description: Folder that contains your TV and Movies folders (e.g. /mnt/user/ or /mnt/user/media/). The app can only see and rename things inside this folder.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User that owns renamed files (99 = nobody, the Unraid default).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group that owns renamed files (100 = users, the Unraid default).

Config.Name: UMASK
Config.Description: Permissions for created folders (000 matches Unraid shares).

Config.Name: Web password
Config.Description: Optional. If set, the browser asks for this password (any user name).
